skincare.name: Skincare
skincare.description: Cleansers, serums, moisturisers and sun care for every skin type, each made to do one job well.

cleansers.name: Cleansers
cleansers.description: Cream, gel and balm cleansers that take everything off and leave nothing tight.

toners-essences.name: Toners and essences
toners-essences.description: Watery layers that add water back after cleansing.

serums.name: Serums
serums.description: Light, concentrated and made to do one job each. Use one or two after cleansing, before your moisturiser.

moisturisers.name: Moisturisers
moisturisers.description: Gel creams for oily skin and rich creams for dry, to seal your serum in.

eye-care.name: Eye care
eye-care.description: Light creams for the thin skin under the eyes.

masks.name: Masks
masks.description: Clay and overnight masks, two or three times a week.

sun-care.name: Sun care
sun-care.description: Sheer sun creams for every morning, and aloe for after.

makeup.name: Makeup
makeup.description: Sheer colour made like skincare: tints, blush, lipstick and the tools to put them on.

base.name: Base
base.description: A sheer tint in twelve shades, and a powder to set it.

cheeks.name: Cheeks
cheeks.description: Cream blush for cheeks and lips.

eyes.name: Eyes
eyes.description: Soft shadows and a mascara that washes off with water.

tools.name: Tools
tools.description: Brushes, cloths and rounds you can wash and keep.

body.name: Body
body.description: Butters, oils and scrubs for the rest of you.

sets-gifts.name: Sets and gifts
sets-gifts.description: Routines and gifts, together for less.

refills.name: Refills
refills.description: Keep the bottle, refill the rest: paper pouches that cost 20% less.

products.name: Oat milk cleanser
products.short: A cream cleanser for dry and sensitive skin that takes off sunscreen without leaving your face tight.
description: Oat and glycerin calm and soften while it cleans, so skin that stings after washing feels comfortable again.
Massage a little into dry or damp skin, morning and night.
Rinse with lukewarm water and pat dry.
Oat, glycerin and a gentle cleansing base. No fragrance, no essential oils, no sulfates.

products.name: Clear gel cleanser
products.short: A clear gel for oily and combination skin that lathers lightly and rinses clean.
description: Zinc PCA helps with oil, and the gel rinses off without squeaky-tight skin after.
Lather a little with water, morning and night.
Zinc PCA, glycerin and a mild cleansing base. No fragrance, no essential oils.

products.name: Melt cleansing balm
products.short: A balm that melts off makeup and sunscreen, then rinses to a milk.
description: Use it first at night to take everything off, then follow with your usual cleanser if you like.
Massage over dry skin for a minute.
Add water to turn it to a milk, then rinse.
Plant oils and a rinse-off emulsifier. No fragrance, no essential oils.

products.name: Rose water toner
products.short: A soft toner with rose water that adds water back after cleansing, with no alcohol.
description: Pat it on after cleansing for skin that feels tight, or before a serum to help it spread.
Shake a few drops into your palms.
Press into your face and neck.
Rose water and glycerin. No alcohol, no added fragrance beyond the rose water itself.

products.name: Calm essence
products.short: A watery essence with centella and oat for skin that flushes and stings.
description: Calms skin after cleansing and before your serum, and suits days when everything else stings.
Pat a few drops into your skin after cleansing.
Follow with your serum or moisturiser.
Centella, oat and panthenol. No fragrance, no essential oils, no alcohol.

products.name: Kiwi glow tonic
products.short: A gentle acid tonic that lifts dullness, two or three evenings a week.
description: 5% lactic acid smooths and brightens, slowly, without the sting of stronger acids.
Sweep over clean skin with a cotton round, two or three evenings a week.
Wear sun cream the next morning.
5% lactic acid, kiwi extract and glycerin. No fragrance, no essential oils.

products.name: Dew Drop niacinamide serum
products.short: A light serum with 5% niacinamide and zinc that evens out shine and calms redness.
description: Two or three drops even out redness and dark marks and keep shine down through the day. Most people see a difference in about four weeks.
Press two or three drops into clean skin, morning and night.
Follow with moisturiser, and SPF in the morning.
Water, 5% niacinamide, 1% zinc PCA, panthenol, glycerin and sodium hyaluronate. No fragrance, no essential oils.
The 50 ml bottle is back soon. Refill pouches for the 30 ml cost 20% less.

products.name: Hyaluronic water serum
products.short: Three sizes of hyaluronic acid for skin that feels tight. Use it on damp skin.
description: A watery serum that holds water in the skin, for any skin type and any time of day.
Press a few drops into damp skin, morning and night.
Follow with moisturiser to seal it in.
Water, hyaluronic acid in three sizes, panthenol and glycerin. No fragrance, no essential oils.

products.name: Bright C serum
products.short: A stable 10% vitamin C for dull skin and dark marks, in the morning under SPF.
description: Brightens dull skin and fades dark marks over a couple of months. Keep it in its box, away from the light.
Press three drops into clean skin in the morning.
Follow with moisturiser and sun cream.
10% vitamin C (ascorbyl glucoside), ferulic acid and glycerin. No fragrance, no essential oils.

products.name: Gentle retinal serum
products.short: Retinal at a strength that suits beginners, for fine lines and texture. Nights only.
description: Retinal works faster than retinol at a lower strength. Start with two nights a week and build up.
Two nights a week at first, a pea-size amount after cleansing.
Moisturise after, and wear sun cream every morning.
0.05% retinal, squalane and ceramides. No fragrance, no essential oils.

products.name: Squalane face oil
products.short: Two drops over moisturiser on dry nights. Light, never greasy.
description: Plant squalane sinks in fast and keeps water in, without a shine.
Press two drops over your moisturiser at night.
On very dry days, mix one drop into your morning cream.
100% plant squalane. No fragrance, no essential oils.

products.name: Ceramide barrier cream
products.short: A rich cream with ceramides for dry, tight skin that needs its barrier back.
description: Thick enough for winter, never greasy. The big jar lasts about three months of twice a day.
Smooth over your face and neck after your serum, morning and night.
Ceramides, cholesterol, squalane and glycerin. No fragrance, no essential oils.

products.name: Water gel cream
products.short: A light gel cream that leaves no shine, for oily and combination skin.
description: Moisture without weight: it sinks in in seconds and sits well under sun cream and makeup.
Smooth over your face after your serum, morning and night.
Glycerin, hyaluronic acid and niacinamide. No fragrance, no essential oils.

products.name: Bright eye cream
products.short: Caffeine and peptides for puffiness and fine lines under the eyes.
description: A light cream for the thin skin under the eyes: tap it in with your ring finger.
Tap a little around the eyes, morning and night.
Caffeine, peptides and glycerin. No fragrance, no essential oils.

products.name: Overnight sleep mask
products.short: A rich mask to leave on overnight, two or three times a week.
description: Wake up to softer, calmer skin. Use it as the last step on dry nights.
Smooth a thin layer over your face as the last step at night.
Shea butter, squalane and oat. No fragrance, no essential oils.

products.name: Pink clay mask
products.short: A soft clay mask that clears pores without drying, ten minutes at a time.
description: Kaolin clay lifts oil from pores without the tight feeling of stronger clays.
Smooth a thin layer over clean skin, avoiding the eyes.
Kaolin clay, glycerin and zinc. No fragrance, no essential oils.

products.name: Mineral SPF 50
products.short: A sheer mineral sun cream with no white cast, gentle enough for sensitive skin.
description: Zinc oxide only, in a sheer cream that leaves no white cast on any skin tone.
Two finger lengths for face and neck, as the last step every morning.
Put more on every two hours in the sun.
Zinc oxide (SPF 50), squalane and glycerin. No fragrance, no essential oils.

products.name: Daily fluid SPF 30
products.short: A sheer fluid that sits well under makeup, for every morning.
description: A runny fluid that disappears into the skin, for days in town.
Two finger lengths for face and neck, as the last step every morning.
UV filters (SPF 30), glycerin and niacinamide. No fragrance, no essential oils.

products.name: After-sun aloe gel
products.short: Cool aloe gel for skin that had too much sun.
description: Keep it in the fridge for the evenings after a day outside.
Smooth over warm skin as often as you like.
Aloe, panthenol and glycerin. No fragrance, no essential oils, no alcohol.

products.name: Dew skin tint
products.short: A sheer tint with SPF 20 that evens skin out without covering it.
description: Twelve shades, each sheer enough to wear alone or under concealer. Find yours in the shade guide.
Dot over your face after moisturiser and blend with your fingers.
Hyaluronic acid, zinc oxide (SPF 20) and mineral pigments. No fragrance, no essential oils.

products.name: Loose setting powder
products.short: A fine powder that takes the shine off without settling into lines.
description: A light dusting over the T-zone keeps shine down until the evening.
Press a little over the T-zone with a powder brush.
Corn starch, silica and mineral pigments. No fragrance.

products.name: Cream blush
products.short: A creamy blush for cheeks and lips that melts in with your fingers.
description: Tap a little onto the apples of your cheeks and blend up. It works on lips too.
Tap onto cheeks with your fingers and blend.
Plant oils, waxes and mineral pigments. No fragrance.

products.name: Satin lipstick
products.short: A comfortable lipstick with a soft satin finish, in five shades.
description: Full colour in one swipe that stays comfortable for hours.
Apply straight from the bullet, or press on with a finger for a softer look.
Plant oils, waxes and mineral pigments. No fragrance.

products.name: Soft neutrals palette
products.short: Nine soft eye shadows, matte and shimmer, that go with everything.
description: Nine shades from cream to taupe, to wear one at a time or blended together.
Sweep with a brush or a fingertip.
Mica, plant oils and mineral pigments. No fragrance.

products.name: Lengthening mascara
products.short: A mascara that lengthens without clumps and washes off with warm water.
description: Tube technology: it wraps each lash and slides off with warm water, no rubbing.
Wiggle from the root to the tips. Two coats for more.
Polymers, waxes and iron oxides. No fragrance.

products.name: Powder brush
products.short: A soft, full brush for powder and blush.
description: Soft synthetic bristles that pick up just enough powder. Wash it once a week with mild soap.

products.name: Brush set
products.short: Eight brushes for base, cheeks and eyes, in a roll-up case.
description: Every brush you need for a full face, in a case that rolls up for travel.

products.name: Muslin face cloths, 3 pack
products.short: Soft muslin cloths for taking off balm cleansers.
description: Wet one with warm water and use it to lift off balm or mask. Wash with your towels.

products.name: Reusable cotton rounds, 10 pack
products.short: Washable rounds for toner and tonic, in a mesh wash bag.
description: Use one for toner or tonic, then wash them all together in the bag they come in.

products.name: Shea body butter
products.short: A rich body butter for dry skin, for after the bath.
description: Shea butter and squalane for elbows, knees and legs that feel dry.
Smooth over damp skin after a bath or shower.
Shea butter, squalane and glycerin. No fragrance, no essential oils.

products.name: Dry body oil
products.short: A light oil that sinks in fast, for arms, legs and hair ends.
description: A dry-touch oil for bare legs in summer, or a drop on the ends of your hair.
Smooth over damp skin after a shower.
Squalane and plant oils. No fragrance, no essential oils.

products.name: Sugar body scrub
products.short: A soft sugar scrub that melts as you use it.
description: Smooths dry patches once or twice a week, then rinses clean.
Massage over damp skin in the shower, then rinse.
Sugar, plant oils and glycerin. No fragrance.

products.name: Hand balm
products.short: A small tin of rich balm for dry hands and cuticles.
description: A tin small enough for a pocket, for hands that are always in water.
Rub a little into hands and cuticles as often as you like.
Shea butter, beeswax-free plant waxes and squalane. No fragrance.

products.name: Mineral bath soak
products.short: Mineral salts for a long, warm bath.
description: A handful in a warm bath. No fragrance: just salts, to soak in for twenty minutes.

products.name: Dry body brush
products.short: A firm natural-bristle brush for dry brushing before a shower.
description: Brush in long strokes towards the heart before a shower. Rinse the bristles once a week.

products.name: The night shift set
products.short: Retinal serum, sleep mask and eye cream for the three steps before bed. Save 20%.
description: Our three night products, together for 20% less: Gentle retinal serum (15 ml), Overnight sleep mask and Bright eye cream.

products.name: Morning glow set
products.short: Oat milk cleanser, Bright C serum and Mineral SPF 50 for a bright start. Save 15%.
description: Three morning steps, together for 15% less.

products.name: Dew Drop serum refill, 30 ml
products.short: A refill pouch of Dew Drop niacinamide serum to pour into your bottle. 20% less than a new bottle.
description: Pour into your clean 30 ml Dew Drop bottle. The pouch goes in your home compost.

products.name: Ceramide barrier cream refill, 50 ml
products.short: A refill pouch of Ceramide barrier cream for your jar. 20% less than a new jar.
description: Squeeze into your clean 50 ml jar. The pouch goes in your home compost.

products.name: Oat milk cleanser refill, 150 ml
products.short: A refill pouch of Oat milk cleanser for your bottle. 20% less than a new bottle.
description: Pour into your clean 150 ml bottle. The pouch goes in your home compost.

products.name: Oat milk cleanser, travel size
products.short: A 30 ml travel size of our oat milk cleanser, free with orders over $60.
description: Our best-selling cleanser in a size for a wash bag. Free with orders over $60 while stocks last.

dew-drop-serum: Two drops every morning under SPF. My T-zone used to be shiny by eleven; now it lasts the day.
The redness round my nose has faded a lot in a month. No stinging at all, which is rare for me.
Works well and the 50 ml lasts ages. It feels slightly tacky for a minute before it sinks in.
oat-milk-cleanser: The first cleanser that hasn’t made my cheeks go red. I’m on my third bottle.
Takes off sunscreen properly and my skin still feels soft after.
ceramide-barrier-cream: Thick enough for winter, never greasy. The big jar lasted me three months.
My skin stopped flaking within a week. I use it morning and night.
mineral-spf-50: Finally a mineral sun cream that doesn’t leave me grey. It disappears in a minute.
Sheer and gentle. A tiny bit thick, so I warm it between my fingers first.
hyaluronic-water-serum: On damp skin it makes everything after it sink in better.
bright-c-serum: My dark marks from spots are fading and it doesn’t sting.
clear-gel-cleanser: Clean without that tight feeling. Lasts a long time.
dew-skin-tint: Sand is perfect for me. It looks like skin, just calmer.
Lovely and sheer. I needed the shade guide to pick.
cream-blush: Petal on cheeks and lips: my whole makeup in one pot.
gentle-retinal-serum: Started twice a week as the post said. No peeling, and my skin is smoother.
